[Unit]
Description=Ultron automated pull-request reviewer
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/ultron autoreview run
Environment=PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
Restart=always
RestartSec=15

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

[Unit]
Description=Ultron automated pull-request reviewer
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/ultron autoreview run
Environment="PATH=/usr/bin:/my bin"
Environment="ULTRON_CODING_AGENT_DIR=/home/me/agent dir"
Restart=always
RestartSec=15

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

[Unit]
Description=Ultron automated pull-request reviewer
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]

Environment=PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>Label</key><string>com.ultron.autoreview</string>
	<key>ProgramArguments</key>
	<array>
		<string>/usr/bin/ultron</string>
		<string>autoreview</string>
		<string>run</string>
	</array>
	<key>EnvironmentVariables</key>
	<dict>
		<key>PATH</key><string>/bin</string>
	</dict>
	<key>KeepAlive</key><true/>
	<key>RunAtLoad</key><true/>
	<key>StandardErrorPath</key><string>/Users/x/Library/Logs/ultron-autoreview.log</string>
</dict>
</plist>

[Unit]
Description=Ultron automated pull-request reviewer
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/opt/node --import "/opt/x y/resolver.ts" /opt/ultron/cli.js autoreview run
Environment=PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
Restart=always
RestartSec=15

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
